item: The erase never touches a marked data drive that is not there (or a different drive at its path), and says so as a failure; a drive lost during the erase is partially erased and unchecked
summary: crypto_erase._drive_state reads data_volume.probe for the folder the first-launch step marked: missing or mismatch is absent, and then nothing under the data folder is read, erased, scoped or removed (custody, lanes, anchors, keys, steps 5b and 6 skipped; main_db and the columnar store only where the overrides put them outside it), the drive id is not forgotten, and the report carries drive_absent with removed False (settle_removed never flips it) and limit = the R809 sentence alone, with no reassurance (finish_holder_check leaves it). A drive that is there has its device read before (the folder's parent on the same device, else the folder as its mount point) and after: gone or changed sets drive_lost, adds the folder to unlisted_folders and leads limit with the partial sentence. The panic page shows 'erase failed', counts what was erased elsewhere as 'Files erased outside the data drive: {done} of {total}.', never removed/clean, and offers no free-space overwrite; the CLI no longer calls data_dir() (it raised on a missing drive), prints ERASE FAILED and exits 2, or 1 when the drive was lost. Strings x12 passed by Plan.
